title: Ariana Grande closes Eternal Sunshine tour with $108m gross
summary: Ariana Grande brought in nearly $108 million (€92m) in gross revenue from 638,000 total tickets for her Eternal Sunshine Tour, the singer’s first widespread outing in seven years, according to new figures.
